messages:
Eva G: heads up — realtime-v2 error rate jumped ~3% in us-east over the last 2m, seeing 503s from the model gateway. thinking we should consider flipping the signal_cutoff flag to mitigate. who can flip right now?

Josh L: can you paste the query/alert? do we have a canary audience to limit impact if we disable? also link runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kill-switchs

Eva G: alert: `rate(ingress_503_count[1m])` spike, dashboard: https://dash.re/redwood/realtime-v2. no canary for this path — it's a global featureflag (signal_cutoff). my suggested scope: turn off for prod-us-east only if possible, fall back to model-legacy.

Samir P: FYI only members of ops-rotations or platform-admins can perform the toggle in prod. policy: toggles that hit global traffic need 2 approvals unless it's an emergency.

Miriam R: quick Q — do we have automatic fallback wired for the clients when signal_cutoff is off? iirc we set model fallback to legacy with a 95% route. if so, flipping should reduce error surface.

Josh L: yep fallback exists. still want to see the trace IDs for errors before flip, but if we hit 5% error sustained >3m i'm fine with temporary flip and gradual restore.

Eva G: at 3m now and trending up. i'm +1 to flip for us-east only. can someone with perms run the toggle and add an audit note with incident id?

Samir P: command to flip (ops-tool):
```
ops-ff toggle --flag signal_cutoff --env prod --region us-east --state off --note "spike-1725004321: reduce 503s, fallback to legacy model" --requester "Eva G"
```

Samir P: also please tag #incidents and #product when you flip. we need to collect logs for postmortem.

platform-bot: preflight check: current error rate 3.2% in us-east, global rate 1.1%. change requires 1 approval from platform-admins OR immediate flip by oncall when error >3% AND trend positive. audit policy will log action to /audit/featureflags.

Miriam R: i can flip. josh — can you post the notable trace IDs to #incidents after i do it?

Josh L: on it. i'll post the top 10 trace ids + a quick note about affected routes.

Miriam R: executing now.

platform-bot: action queued: ops-ff toggle request received from Miriam R. awaiting backend confirmation...

Miriam R: done — turned signal_cutoff OFF for prod us-east. audit id: af3b2c9e. posted to #incidents.

platform-bot: audit record created: id=af3b2c9e, actor=Miriam R, flag=signal_cutoff, env=prod, region=us-east, state=off, note="spike-1725004321: reduce 503s".

Eva G: confirmed seeing error rate drop to 0.8% within 45s. nice work. leaving this thread open for 30m to watch.

Samir P: file a short postmortem link in the audit ticket and include the toggle timeline. reminder: if revert is needed, follow the runbook steps for gradual re-enable with a canary cohort.

Miriam R: will do. posted timeline and notes to the audit ticket: https://audit.redwood/af3b2c9e

Josh L: thanks all — i'll add trace dump and tag SRE + ML infra for follow-up. :thumbsup:

Eva G: thanks team :heart:
